title: Skycast
description: SkyCast is a smart weather app that delivers real-time forecasts with a clean and user-friendly interface.
keyFeatures: Real-time Weather Updates – Fetches live weather data using API integration.
📍 Location-based Forecasts – Provides weather details based on user’s location.
🔍 Search Functionality – Allows users to check weather for any city worldwide.
📊 Detailed Forecast – Displays temperature, humidity, wind speed, and conditions.
🎨 Clean & Responsive UI – Built with React for a smooth and user-friendly experience.
⚡ Fast Performance – Optimized state management for quick data rendering.
